l.i: rum verbi Dei, sicut nihil unquam in Religione
Christiana profectum est, sic Nihil unquam aut
proficitur[?], aut proficí potest. Tantum cavendum
est, ne dominentur Gregi. Quod tamen ipsius Petri
Tempore potius in ipsorum Pastorum voluntate, quam
in Freno aliquo Ipsis quodammodo à Populo injiciendo,
quibus hac de Re, non quidem Populo, sed ipsis
Pastoribus, damnur[?] Praecepta. Similia quaedam in
Epistolis Pauli ad Timotheum & Titum scripta extant.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "proficitur" (possibly printed differently), "damnur" (likely "dantur" or similar, flagged as [?]). The reading of the running head is taken as printed. Faint show-through of text from the reverse page is visible in the middle right of the page and was left out. The catchword "Ex" is taken from the bottom right of the page.
